global_findings.finding: Opening roar and repeated nation-oracle formula create a sequence stronger than chapter boundaries.
Hear-word formulas, oaths, seek-live, lament-woe, and name hymns provide discourse seams.
Vision formulas establish a five-vision macro-sequence interrupted, not ended, by Amaziah.
Temporal formulas and repair-plant verbs bind the restoration coda.
No chapter-sized placeholder is proposed; seams require formula, form, scene, vision, or movement evidence.
